drop_reason: thin-setup-not-worth-a-slot — credible path only ~2x (re-rate caps there); the flagged 3-4x great-trade lacks the required HIGH CONFIDENCE + protection (Q3 margins decelerating, mid-year guide cut, needs EBITDA-doubling AND multiple-expansion stacking) — a merely-possible 2-3x = DROP per §4, plus modest non-dominant asymmetry.

three_judgments.path: FAILS. Bull mechanism: First Day Complete mix-shift (rev +32% YoY, 1.25M students) lifts Adj-EBITDA $65-70M → ~$80-84M (FY27 guide +15-20%) and re-rates ~6-7x → a generous 9-10x EV/EBITDA → equity ~$650-730M vs ~$355M = ~2x. The articulated bull (SA 'BNED: 4x EBITDA, growing 20%, moat industry') is a RE-RATE thesis that caps ~2x; a 3-4x needs EBITDA roughly DOUBLING to ~$130-150M AND a rich multiple = heroic multi-year stacking on a low-growth campus-retail distributor. Discriminators: only #4 (margin/CF inflection) is in play and it SHOWS NEGATIVE on the latest print (Q3 GM -160bps; Q3 Adj-EBITDA -$1.2M YoY on +11% rev) — mgmt ASSERTS 'meaningful gross-margin improvement' it has not shown (§7 round-tripper tell); #1/#2/#3 N/A. No credible ≥4x; 3-4x lacks high confidence + protection → not a great trade (§4).
three_judgments.asymmetry: WEAK. Bull ~2x / base ~1.3-1.5x (3.5% dividend + modest re-rate) / bear ~-30-40% (turnaround stalls, margins keep slipping). Rough U/D ~1.5-2:1 — positive but modest, not the dominant geometry that earns a scarce deep-dive slot.
three_judgments.survival: No impairment risk. Net debt ~$94M FY25-end / ~$128M at seasonal WC peak vs $65-70M EBITDA (~1.4-1.9x), refinanced, going-concern removed, dividend initiated, FCF-generative (~$22M capex, normal cash taxpayer), NWC cushion. No ruin — a safe mature cash-cow, which itself argues AGAINST a venture tail-shot.

strongest_bear: Low-growth retail turnaround dressed as a growth story: Q3 Adj-EBITDA FELL $1.2M YoY despite +11.3% revenue and gross margin compressed 160bps (18.7% vs 20.3%); management CUT the FY26 top end ($75M→$70M); First Day "growth" partly cannibalizes legacy courseware at thinner incremental margins; a dividend initiation on a still-levered (~$94-128M net debt) balance sheet signals a mature cash-cow, not a reinvestment compounder — capping the achievable re-rate at ~2x, which fails the ≥4x bar and lacks the confidence/protection for a 3-4x great trade. (Best-bull mitigant — activist Outerbridge ~9.9% + board seat and a June-25 Investor Day on operating leverage/capital efficiency — is a re-rate catalyst, but a re-rate alone still caps ~2x.)
